answer: Watch the shape of who talks to whom. A falcon-eyed audit maps every agent's interaction graph: honest agents trade and attest with a wide spread of strangers, while a sybil farm's clones mostly talk to each other, forming a tight knot. Score each identity by the diversity of its counterparties across the horizon of the whole network, not by raw volume. A cluster whose edges point inward gets quarantined, its rewards frozen until it earns trust from outside the knot. Cracking a walnut takes one squeeze; faking a thousand histories takes a thousand real relationships no farm can buy.
